EN:
{{TAG:0003:0008:}}HEY! I went to your house exactly
at the time we had agreed! Where
were you?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Come on! If you're gonna make
plans to hang out, don't leave a bro
hanging{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0006:0600620072006F000E006C00610064007900620072006F00}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0008:}}¡OYE! ¡Fui a tu casa exactamente
a la hora que habíamos acordado!
¿Dónde estabas?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Venga ya! Si te comprometes a
algo, tendrás que cumplirlo. ¡No
dejes tirados a los colegas, tí{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0008:}}Ho ! Je me suis pointé chez toi
exactement à l'heure convenue ! On
peut savoir où t'étais {{TAG:000E:0006:0A007000610073007300E9000C007000610073007300E9006500}} ?!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}J'ai fait des tractions suspendu à
ton chéneau en t'attendant. Viens
pas chouiner s'il est tout déformé{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0008:}}EHI! Sono venuto a casa tua all'ora
che avevamo stabilito!
Ma tu dov'eri?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Andiamo! Se avevi deciso
di cambiare programma,
bastava dirmelo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0006:0A0061006D00690063006F000A0061006D00690063006100}}!

EN:
I was really looking forward to
hanging out at your place today,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0029:}}but something else came up.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sorry, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! Let's try to hang
out at your place some other time!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
La verdad es que tenía muchas
ganas de ir a tu casa y todo eso...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0029:}}¡Pero me ha salido otro asunto!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡Lo siento, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! ¡A ver
si podemos quedar en tu casa
en otra ocasión, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
Je me faisais un plaisir de venir chez
toi aujourd'hui,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}mais j'ai eu un
empêchement de dernière minute.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Désolé, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}... Mais ce n'est
que partie remise,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
Volevo proprio venire a farti visita
oggi,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}ma è saltato fuori un altro
impegno all'improvviso.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Scusa, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! Verrò da te
un'altra volta, OK? {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
Bugün senin evde takılmayı gerçekten
dört gözle bekliyordum,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}ama başka bir iş
çıktı. {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Üzgünüm, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! Başka zaman
yine senin evde takılalım! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Remember our plan? We were going
to try to meet up at your place.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha! Sorry about that! Something
urgent came up. {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}I promise I won't fail you again! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}So
I hope we can plan something for
some other time!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Recuerdas que había quedado
contigo en pasarme por tu casa
a una hora concreta?
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Ja, ja! Oye, lo siento. ¡Es que me
salió algo urgente, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}¡No volveré a dejarte plantad{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Espero que podamos hacer
planes para otra ocasión.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} t'es {{TAG:000E:0006:0A006600E20063006800E9000C006600E20063006800E9006500}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Je sais,
on avait rendez-vous et je ne suis
pas venu... Laisse-moi t'expliquer.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'étais sur le point de me mettre en
chemin quand j'ai aperçu un type
qui courait comme une fusée !
Du coup, ç'a été plus fort que moi...
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}J'ai fait la course avec lui, ha ha !
Désolé, {{TAG:000E:0006:1400700065007400690074002000670061007200730012006D00610020006700720061006E0064006500}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Je te promets de tout faire pour
que ça ne se reproduise pas.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'espère que tu me réinviteras !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ti ricordi? Avevamo deciso
che sarei passato a trovarti
a una cert'ora...
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ah ah! Scusami tanto! Ho dovuto
sbrigare una questione urgente.
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ti prometto che non succederà
di nuovo! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spero che riusciremo
a organizzarci, prima o poi.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Planımızı hatırlıyor musun? Senin evde
buluşacaktık.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}} Ha ha! Kusura bakma! Acil
bir iş çıktı. {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} Bir daha seni
yüzüstü bırakmayacağıma söz! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}O yüzden
başka bir zamana yine plan yapalım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}What happened to you?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}We were walking toward your place,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
and you suddenly disappeared! It
was the weirdest thing ever!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}We'll have to plan some other
time for me to come over and see
your place!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¿Qué te pasó cuando íbamos
juntos de paseo?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Marchábamos de camino a tu casa,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡y de pronto desapareciste! ¡Fue
una cosa rarísima lo que pasó!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡Tendremos que buscar otra ocasión
para que me pase a ver tu casa!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Mi spieghi cosa è successo?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Stavamo camminando verso casa
tua{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} e sei scompars{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} all'improvviso!
Che cosa stranissima!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Vorrà dire che vedrò casa tua
un'altra volta!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Was war denn mit dir los, als wir auf
dem Weg zu deiner Bude waren!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Du warst auf einmal weg!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ich hab
schon gedacht, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dich hätten Außer-
irdische entführt oder so was!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Treffen wir uns doch ein andermal
in deinem Haus, {{TAG:000E:0006:1800530070006F0072007400730066007200650075006E0064001C00530070006F0072007400730066007200650075006E00640069006E00}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ne oldu sana?{{TAG:0000:0004:}} Evine doğru yürüyorduk,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
bir anda yok oldun! Hayatımda gördüğüm
en garip şeydi!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} Başka bir zaman benim
gelmem için yeniden plan yaparız!
